description:
Download Version 1.3.1 Here

Requires Lazylib.

This mod is a continuation/fork of AppleMarineXX's original UNSC mod.

Version 2.0.0 Core Continued (October 9th, 2026)
New version is out, compatible with the other UNSC mods and with its own unique identity to help separate it. It has a new thread and Github repo to prevent anyone using this, now legacy version, from blindly updating to a version that will break their saves. For anyone who already started a game with this thread's mod, there are migration instructions to convert your save to be 2.0.0 compatible.

Version 1.3.1 Changes (October 7th 2026)

Added Treasure Hunt 2.3.0 integration for the UNSC Blueprint Package one-time reward pool.
Added custom descriptions for Epsilon Eridani I, Circumstance, Beta Gabriel, Tantalus, and Site 17.
Added a 128x128 project icon for TriOS and similar launchers/managers.
Removed dead UNSC_hullconstruction description-parameter code without changing the hullmod's gameplay effects.
Normalized the public and Version Checker version identity to 1.3.1.

Important Note Going Forward (October 7th 2026)
I started working on this continuation before I learned about the other 2 UNSC forks, Halo HomeSystems and UNSC Reborn. Since this is the newest fork, I decided to do another full namespace migration to make sure future work on this fork stays compatible with those other 2 mods, should people want to use this one along with one of the others. To prevent anyone who already downloaded and started using this fork, from getting their save game broken, I am creating a new thread and Github repo for the next major version which will be UNSC Core Continued. I will update this thread with more info when the next version is ready, but I wanted to make sure anyone who may update the mod doesn't get screwed over if they don't see a notice on this thread.

ie: TriOS will NOT update this mod beyond 1.3.1. Your saves are safe.
Also Im working on a solution for people who want to carry their save over to the next major version.

About

United Nations Space Command - Continued is a continuation of AppleMarineXX's original Halo-themed UNSC faction mod for Starsector.

The goal of this continuation is to preserve the identity of the original mod while bringing it forward to current Starsector versions, fixing issues, improving compatibility with other mods, and continuing to expand and polish the UNSC content.

This continuation is maintained with permission from the original author.

New Features in 1.03 (First Public Release of Continuation)

Some of the larger updates made during the continuation project include:

Reworked and expanded home system into a recreation of Epsilon Eridani (Reach's solar system)
Added exploration locations, caches, debris fields, and UNSC wrecks to home system
Added optional Industrial Evolution integration. If IndEvo is enabled, Reach will have a Railgun Artillery Station
Standardized UNSC internal content IDs for better long-term maintainability & stability
Created optional Nexerelin colony-expedition naming support. If Nex is installed, new UNSC colonies on planets with generic names (system name #) will get renamed from a special pool of planet names from the Halo universe.
Fixed several small inherited world-generation and compatibility issues
Cleaned up obsolete files and rebuilt the Java portion of the mod against current dependencies
Resolved an issue where a bundled lazylib library was causing some glitchy behavior in the console
Higher resolution ship hull and fighter hull graphics.
Removed Unused Files
Version Checker (lunalib) support

New Ship Graphics

Epsilon Eridani

Coming Soon
Mostly a few technical cleanup/housekeeping tasks of low importance. Figured I'd share this release in the mean time. Once those are done, will be looking at additional integrations with other mods, and exploring possible content additions.

Installation

Download the release ZIP and extract the contained folder into your Starsector mods directory.

Make sure only one copy of the UNSC mod is installed and enabled at a time.
*This fork is not compatabile with Halo HomeSystems or UNSC Reborn.

Enable LazyLib along with any optional supported mods you wish to use.

If you encounter any bugs, please post your log here, a screenshot of the error, and if possible your mod list and I will work on it ASAP.

Optional mod integrations:

Nexerelin
Industrial Evolution
Treasure Hunt
Commissioned Crews
Starpocalypse

Save Compatibility

The continuation underwent a major internal identifier cleanup & unification.

Old saves are not compatible, however if someone has a treasured save file they would like to use with this new version, dm me a link to a zip of your save game you want migrated and I can try to migrate it and send it back. In the process of development I created a script that can do this, so it might work for others, but I can't guarantee anything other than I'll give it a shot for anyone who requests it.

Credits

Original mod: AppleMarineXX
